number: 109
title: Declare commands and options in one registry
milestone: M2.5
labels:
  - kind: refactor
  - area: cli
parent: m2.5-p5-application-and-cli
---

`CommandLine.Run` reads arguments in strict pairs (a missing value shifts every later option), ignores unknown options, runs benchmark and task matching for every command, and keeps usage text twice by hand; `--only` is parsed three ways with different errors; exit codes are bare integers; and the README misses `reach`, `advise` and ten options.
We want a registry: each command declares its name, help and options (name, value type, default, help), and parsing, errors, usage, exit codes and the README command table all come from it.

Its responsibilities are:
* Option declarations shared between commands that take the same option
* Parsing that rejects unknown options and missing values, naming them
* An `ExitCode` enum (success, unsolved, refuted, differs, usage)
* A test that the README command table matches the registry
* Settings descriptors the menu also uses, so a menu item and a flag for one setting are declared once

Existing command lines in RESEARCH.md and the README should still run unchanged, because results there are reproduced by them.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Cli/CommandLine.cs`, `CommandOptions.cs`, `InputParsing.cs`, `PartCommands.cs`, `VerifyCommand.cs`, `TargetCommands.cs`, `SettingsMenu.cs`, `SearchMenu.cs`, `TargetMenu.cs`; `README.md`.

Done when:
- [ ] An unknown option or a missing value fails with a message naming it and the usage exit code
- [ ] Usage text and the README table are generated from or checked against the registry
- [ ] Every command line quoted in RESEARCH.md and the README parses
- [ ] `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "Using the GUI", "Benchmarking and choosing an algorithm"
